decisive_items: Hypercellular marrow consisting of 80% plasma cells with atypical morphology and κ-light-chain restriction
Abnormal paraprotein band on serum and urine protein electrophoreses
Monoclonal IgG-κ protein on immunofixation electrophoresis
response.rationale: The patient's laboratory and biopsy findings, including hypercellular marrow with plasma cell infiltration, abnormal paraprotein band, and monoclonal IgG-κ protein, are characteristic of multiple myeloma.

rejected.why: Limited support from single finding of hypercalcemia
Lack of specific findings beyond elevated cryoglobulin levels
Similar to R3, limited support from cryoglobulinemia findings
